caption: The video captures a calm coastal scene at a low sun, the bright disc hanging near the horizon beneath a heavy overcast sky. A dark cliff rises on the right, crowned by a pale house, and the framing of these elements stays steady. A vertical column of shimmering reflection runs from the sun down across the sea, wobbling gently as the surface ripples. The lower edge shows a dark pebble beach, where a thin residual foam line lingers at the right side. A faint crest line emerges in the lower-left water, marking a small wave already rolling shoreward. This wave translates diagonally toward the beach, its crest steepening as it approaches the shallows. The crest then collapses into a line of white foam along the water's edge on the left. The glittering path and the still cliff remain constant while this wave advances and breaks.
relations: The sun's vertical shimmering column persists as surface ripples wobble its reflection path.
A faint lower-left crest, if it emerges, translates diagonally shoreward and steepens in the shallows.
That crest collapses into a white foam line along the left water's edge as it reaches the beach.
The dark cliff and pale house hold steady framing while the wave advances and breaks.
